purpose: Matched original-weight FP32 validation versus fixed experiment 17b INT8; not training or independent final evaluation
split: validation only, 607 cases; original 4096-byte/64-word scope yields 553 before token exclusions
protocol: same documented noul state, question and two option orders as 17b; forward true probability is primary; reverse and average are diagnostics
primary: eligible matched AUC; gate >=0.60 and >= matched BM25+0.03, unchanged from 17b
baseline: 17b fixed INT8 aggregate and development-only BM25 statistics
execution: Go prepares only validation inputs without labels; Python original FP32 CPU scores them; Go verifies exact request sequence and evaluates
token_parity: Python independently reconstructs upstream tokens/markers for every request and aborts on mismatch
limits: checked between calls; not a within-call hard cap
reserves: read only during original full-source hashing and group partitioning; never model-scored
